runs.summary: No exact-match competitor survived the full Malay/English API and visible-browser audit; the closest local same-mold listing lacked proof of the ValueSnap gift-box bundle.

ourProduct.title: Electric Waving Hand Lucky Cat Kucing Bertuah Melambai Tangan Gold Ceramic Fortune Cat Figurine Patung Kucing Rezeki 招財貓

strengths.finding: ValueSnap clearly offers a six-style ceramic set with a red floral cloth mat and gift box.
strengths.evidence: Live product description, package list, and variation images verified during this run.

strengths.finding: ValueSnap is RM3.13 below the closest rejected same-mold 7-inch option on current listed price.
strengths.evidence: ValueSnap Wealth Bucket White is RM74.26; the rejected near-match 7inch A is RM77.39. It was not accepted because its gift-box bundle was not proved.

gaps.finding: The ValueSnap size copy is internally inconsistent.
gaps.evidence: Description says a 7-inch option and also cites 23 × 15 × 20 cm, while live variation artwork shows 18–19 cm width and 16–18 cm height.

gaps.finding: No true exact competitor remained after bundle, eligibility, material, mechanism, and visual checks.
gaps.evidence: 84 plausible lucky-cat listings were reviewed; overseas, Mall, pre-order, plastic, solar, different-design, or unproved-bundle listings were rejected.

recommendations.recommendation: Correct the size wording so the description and all six variation dimensions agree.
recommendations.evidence: Live copy currently mixes 7-inch, 23 × 15 × 20 cm, and variation heights of 16–18 cm.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduce buyer uncertainty and make future like-for-like comparisons cleaner.
recommendations.ownerNextStep: Listing owner to verify physical dimensions and draft corrected copy for approval.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep the gift-box-plus-cloth-mat bundle prominent in the title and first description block.
recommendations.evidence: The bundle was the decisive difference that excluded the closest same-mold listing.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Make the buyer-value advantage easier to understand.
recommendations.ownerNextStep: Content owner to prepare a title and first-bullet proposal; no live edit in this workflow.

recommendations.recommendation: Add one variation matrix image with exact style names, dimensions, and package contents.
recommendations.evidence: Six style names are present, but current dimension evidence is spread across different listing sections.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Improve option clarity and reduce selection mistakes.
recommendations.ownerNextStep: Creative owner to prepare a verified matrix using measured dimensions.

recommendations.recommendation: Track rejected near-match 24712845:29571081402 separately as a market benchmark, not as an exact competitor.
recommendations.evidence: Its 7inch A shares the same mold and recorded 187 API monthly sold, but the gift-box bundle was not proved.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Preserve useful market monitoring without weakening the exact-match standard.
recommendations.ownerNextStep: Repeat a read-only check in the next competitor cycle.

recommendations.recommendation: Repeat the full bilingual search before the main Chinese New Year demand window.
recommendations.evidence: The current complete search found no exact buyer-equivalent set.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Detect new exact listings or bundle changes when category activity rises.
recommendations.ownerNextStep: Schedule a fresh read-only analysis closer to the seasonal window.

runs.noExactMatchFinding: No exact match found after both Malay and English keywords were checked through three API pages and three visible browser pages each. The closest same-mold local listing did not prove the gift-box bundle, so near-matches were not padded into the result.
